regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours these unsettled, though by the mercy of God, greately privileged days. I am sure we all here at the Monastery hope that things in general at least are going fairly well your way and with your business. I received notice from your establishment several years ago, anouncing your having taken over the publication of the divinely privileged - "inspired" Life of the Bl. Virgin Mary; the Mysti- cal City of God. I hardly remember the particulars of the situ- ation at the time but I've regretted since, my comparative in- activity in such a divinely privileged work.
